boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of North Dakota
boards.description: Ten named Grand Forks food destinations with publicly listed late operating hours; confirm service options before leaving campus.

cards.title: Roadhouse Cafe
cards.subtitle: 4720 Gateway Dr, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Head to the Simonson Travel Center location when you need a full meal at an unusual hour; its official site says it is open 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour café inside Simonson Travel Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Roadhouse Cafe states that it is located at 4720 Gateway Dr and is open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Roadhouse Cafe
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the café as open 24 hours every day; located inside Simonson Travel Center.

cards.title: Taco Bell on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1301 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or dine-in option after an evening out; the location lists 3 a.m. closes most nights and 4 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A South Washington stop with especially late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists this Grand Forks location's drive-thru hours until 3 a.m. daily except Friday and Saturday, when it lists 4 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1301 S Washington St
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists drive-thru until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; it also lists dine-in hours.

cards.title: Wendy’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1503 S Washington, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Plan for a late drive-thru or restaurant stop on South Washington; Wendy’s lists both restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A daily 2 a.m. Wendy’s location.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. every day for 1503 S Washington.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 1503 S Washington
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru service until 2 a.m. every day.

cards.title: McDonald’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1125 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Choose the drive-thru when the lobby has closed; the official listing shows drive-thru service through midnight every day and lobby service through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A South Washington drive-thru listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists drive-thru hours until midnight daily at 1125 S Washington St; restaurant lobby hours are listed until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 1125 S Washington St
cards.access_notes: Official listing shows drive-thru until 12 a.m. daily; lobby service is listed until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Domino’s on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 2705 S Washington, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Order carryout or delivery from this named South Washington store; its official location page currently shows service until 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery option listed until 1 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page identifies its 2705 S Washington Grand Forks store and states it is open until 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's — 2705 S Washington
cards.access_notes: Official location page currently states “Today Until 1:00 AM”; verify the day-specific closing time when ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on South Washington
cards.subtitle: 1418 S Washington St, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to check delivery or carryout for this South Washington restaurant, which is listed as open until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A pizza delivery and carryout location listed through midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut's Grand Forks location page lists the 1418 S Washington St restaurant as open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — Grand Forks locations
cards.access_notes: Official location listing says the 1418 S Washington St restaurant is open until midnight.

cards.title: Culver’s on 32nd Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 3451 32nd Avenue South, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru or Curdside pickup for the later window here; Culver’s lists those services through 11 p.m., after its 10 p.m. lobby close.
cards.short_summary: Drive-thru and Curdside service listed until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists daily Curdside and drive-thru hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. for its 3451 32nd Avenue South location.
cards.source_title: Culver's — 32nd Ave S, Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Official page lists lobby and dine-in until 10 p.m.; Curdside and drive-thru are listed until 11 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Perkins Restaurant & Bakery, 1305 S Columbia Road
cards.title: Perkins on South Columbia
cards.subtitle: 1305 S Columbia Road, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Set this up as a sit-down or takeout option before the 11 p.m. close; Perkins lists restaurant dining and bakery service at this address.
cards.short_summary: A restaurant-and-bakery option listed until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins lists its 1305 S Columbia Road Grand Forks restaurant hours as 6 a.m.–11 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Perkins — Grand Forks, ND
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours until 11 p.m. every day.

cards.title: Skies 322 at The Olive Ann
cards.subtitle: 322 Demers Avenue, downtown Grand Forks
cards.notes: Make this a downtown dinner plan rather than a last-minute dash: the restaurant lists Friday and Saturday dinner service through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A downtown hotel restaurant with midnight weekend dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Skies 322 lists dinner hours until midnight on Friday and Saturday at 322 Demers Avenue.
cards.source_title: Skies 322 Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Official site lists dinner 3 p.m.–12 a.m. Friday–Saturday; Sunday–Thursday dinner is listed until 11 p.m.

cards.title: Denny’s on 32nd Avenue South
cards.subtitle: 3770 32nd Avenue South, Grand Forks
cards.notes: Keep this 32nd Avenue South diner in mind for an all-hours meal; Grand Forks’ visitor bureau lists the location as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A diner listed as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Grand Forks lists the Denny's at 3770 32nd Avenue South as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Visit Grand Forks — Denny's
cards.access_notes: The Grand Forks visitor bureau lists this Denny's as open 24 hours; confirm before traveling.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented campus spaces for studying, meeting, reflection, recreation, art, and student support beyond a standard tour stop.

cards.entity_name: Memorial Union Third Floor Study Space
cards.title: Memorial Union Third Floor Study Space
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, third floor
cards.notes: Bring a reading or laptop upstairs when you need a calmer work setting; UND identifies this floor as dedicated to quiet study, reading, and assignments.
cards.short_summary: A window-lined quiet-work floor inside the campus union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Memorial Union's third floor as a calm, quiet space for students to study, read, or complete assignments.
cards.source_title: Artworks | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Located in the Memorial Union; follow current building access and room-use guidance.

cards.title: Memorial Union Gaming Area
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 006
cards.notes: Use the lower-level games area as a planned break between classes; check the Union building map for its room location before heading down.
cards.short_summary: A named lower-level recreation stop in the Memorial Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists the Gaming Area in Memorial Union Room 006 among the building's amenities.
cards.source_title: Services & Amenities | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: In Room 006; access follows Memorial Union operating and event conditions.

cards.title: Memorial Union Gallery
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, main level
cards.notes: Pause for the current exhibition while crossing the Union; the gallery rotates shows about every 90 days and highlights campus and visiting artists.
cards.short_summary: A student-operated gallery with regularly changing exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says the Memorial Union Gallery hosts multiple exhibitions yearly, changing approximately every 90 days, and is operated by students.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Gallery | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The gallery page posts current exhibition dates and gallery hours; verify them before visiting.

cards.title: Pride Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 204
cards.notes: Stop in to socialize, study, ask for support, or connect with resources; appointments are recommended when you need guaranteed staff meeting time.
cards.short_summary: A staffed Union space for connection, study, and LGBTQIA2S+ support.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Pride Center as a welcoming space where students can socialize, study, find support, and connect to resources.
cards.source_title: About Us | Pride Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room 204; open during Memorial Union business hours, with staff listed Monday through Friday, 8 a.m.–4:30 p.m.

cards.title: The Hilyard Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 201
cards.notes: Visit for connection and student-support programming, or speak with staff about resources and identity exploration; appointments and drop-ins are both noted by UND.
cards.short_summary: A Memorial Union center built around belonging, collaboration, and student support.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says The Hilyard Center cultivates connections, shared experiences, acceptance, student support, and programming.
cards.source_title: The Hilyard Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Located in Memorial Union Room 201; confirm current staff availability before a dedicated visit.

cards.title: International Center
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Suite 300
cards.notes: Check its programming calendar or contact the center for support and conversation sessions; it serves international and domestic campus engagement.
cards.short_summary: A Union-based hub for international student support and global engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that its International Center supports students through advising, programming, and free English Conversation Sessions.
cards.source_title: International Student & Scholar Services | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Suite 300 in the Memorial Union; English Conversation Sessions require contacting the center to sign up.

cards.title: Memorial Union Reflection Room
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union, Room 339
cards.notes: Use this designated reflection space for a quiet pause or spiritual practice; be considerate of others and check room availability before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A named upper-floor space for reflection and spiritual wellbeing.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists Memorial Union Reflection Room 339 among its campus spiritual wellness spaces.
cards.source_title: Religion & Spirituality | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room 339; availability may be affected by scheduled observances or programming.

cards.title: Wellness Center Resource Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center, first floor
cards.notes: Bring coursework to the Resource Lounge when a wellness-focused study setting helps; members can use its computers for email, homework, or research.
cards.short_summary: A wellness-center study nook with health resources and computers.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Wellness Center Resource Lounge as a study space with computers for homework, email, and health-information searches.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The Wellness Center requires a membership card for facility entry; confirm membership eligibility and facility hours.

cards.title: Hopper Danley Memorial Quiet Lounge
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center, first floor
cards.notes: Choose this lounge for quiet studying, meditation, or a reset between commitments; its outdoor view and floor labyrinth support reflective use.
cards.short_summary: A quiet Wellness Center lounge designed for reflection and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says the Hopper Danley Memorial Quiet Lounge is intended for meditation, relaxation, and quiet studying and includes a floor labyrinth.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Inside the Wellness Center; facility entry requires a membership card.

cards.entity_name: Chester Fritz Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library
cards.notes: Coordinate a group session in a library study room when available, and leave the room clean and orderly after using shared equipment and furnishings.
cards.short_summary: Library rooms intended for collaborative academic work and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: UND classifies Chester Fritz Library rooms as including Group Study Rooms and states that study spaces support group study, collaboration, and presentation practice.
cards.source_title: Room Policy | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room use is subject to library policy, reservations, and priority uses; non-UND use needs approval.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten scheduled or year-round Grand Forks activities with direct evidence of free admission or participation.

cards.title: Team up for The Welly Cup
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center · Aug. 29, 2026
cards.notes: Form a team for 3v3 basketball, pickleball doubles, or sand volleyball; complete the required free team registration before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A one-day, three-sport student tournament.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists The Welly Cup as a free event and states that free team registration is required.
cards.source_title: The Welly Cup | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Current students, faculty, and staff; Saturday, Aug. 29, 2026, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. at the Wellness Center outdoor courts.

cards.title: Climb under the glow at Cosmic Climbing
cards.subtitle: Wellness Center Rock Wall · Oct. 18–31, 2026
cards.notes: Bring or wear glow gear and use the Rock Wall during normal hours while its routes are lit for the Cosmic Climbing program.
cards.short_summary: A low-light climbing session at UND’s Rock Wall.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists Cosmic Climbing as a free event at the Wellness Center Rock Wall.
cards.source_title: Cosmic Climbing | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Student ID required; scheduled Oct. 18–31, 2026 during normal Rock Wall hours.

cards.title: Drop into the Super Smash Bros. League
cards.subtitle: Nexus Gaming Lounge · selected fall 2026 dates
cards.notes: Show up to play at the Nexus Gaming Lounge, earn league points across sessions, and join without advance registration.
cards.short_summary: A casual semester-long campus gaming league.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists the Super Smash Bros. League as free and says no registration is required.
cards.source_title: Super Smash Bros. League | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Student ID required; dates include Aug. 27, Sept. 9, Oct. 20, Nov. 18, and Dec. 9, 2026, 6–9 p.m.

cards.entity_name: UND Homecoming Pep Rally in Town Square
cards.title: Join the Homecoming Pep Rally
cards.subtitle: Town Square · Oct. 1, 2026
cards.notes: Meet downtown for the program, band, cheer and dance appearances, yard games, and time to mingle with UND teams.
cards.short_summary: A public downtown kickoff for UND Homecoming.
cards.evidence_claim: UND lists the 2026 Homecoming Pep Rally as a $0 free event open to the entire community.
cards.source_title: UND Homecoming Pep Rally in Town Square | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: No student ID required; Thursday, Oct. 1, 2026, 5:30–7:30 p.m. at Town Square, 1 S. 3rd St.

cards.title: Walk the Cruz-In Forks car show
cards.subtitle: Downtown Grand Forks · Aug. 27 or Sept. 24, 2026
cards.notes: Walk N. 3rd Street from Demers Avenue to view classic cars, hot rods, and muscle cars during the fourth-Thursday show.
cards.short_summary: A downtown evening of cars and community.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that Cruz-In Forks is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Cruz-In Forks Downtown Car Show | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: No student ID required; 5–8 p.m. on Aug. 27 and Sept. 24, 2026; cars line N. 3rd Street beginning at Demers Avenue.

cards.title: Catch the Monday Movie
cards.subtitle: Josephine Campbell Recital Hall · Aug. 24, 2026
cards.notes: First-year Arts and Sciences students can meet college leaders, then stay for the scheduled screening in the Hughes Fine Arts Center.
cards.short_summary: An orientation-week movie and connection event.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Monday Movie screening as a free event for first-year College of Arts & Sciences students.
cards.source_title: Monday Movie – Project Hail Mary | University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: For College of Arts & Sciences first-year students; Monday, Aug. 24, 2026, 1–4 p.m.; no student ID required.

cards.entity_name: North Dakota Soccer vs. UW-Green Bay
cards.title: Watch North Dakota Soccer vs. UW-Green Bay
cards.subtitle: Bronson Field · Aug. 16, 2026
cards.notes: Bring a friend to Bronson Field for the listed home match and check the UND calendar again before heading out for event updates.
cards.short_summary: A free UND women’s soccer home fixture.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s events calendar lists North Dakota Soccer vs. UW-Green Bay at Bronson Field as FREE.
cards.source_title: University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Sunday, Aug. 16, 2026, noon; calendar listing identifies Bronson Field and marks the match FREE.

cards.title: Watch North Dakota Soccer vs. Presbyterian
cards.subtitle: Bronson Field · Aug. 27, 2026
cards.notes: Use the calendar listing to plan a free afternoon at Bronson Field for this scheduled North Dakota Soccer home match.
cards.short_summary: A free late-August UND soccer match.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s events calendar lists North Dakota Soccer vs. Presbyterian at Bronson Field as FREE.
cards.source_title: University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Thursday, Aug. 27, 2026, 3 p.m.; calendar listing identifies Bronson Field and marks the match FREE.

cards.entity_name: North Dakota Soccer vs. Prairie View A&M
cards.title: Watch North Dakota Soccer vs. Prairie View A&M
cards.subtitle: Bronson Field · Aug. 30, 2026
cards.notes: Meet at Bronson Field for the listed Sunday home fixture, then confirm any day-of updates through UND’s events calendar.
cards.short_summary: A free Sunday soccer outing on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s events calendar lists North Dakota Soccer vs. Prairie View A&M at Bronson Field as FREE.
cards.source_title: University of North Dakota Events Calendar
cards.access_notes: Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026, noon; calendar listing identifies Bronson Field and marks the match FREE.

cards.title: Take a Greenway trail walk
cards.subtitle: Along the Red and Red Lake rivers · Grand Forks
cards.notes: Choose a section of the multi-use trail system for a walk, bike ride, or quiet riverfront loop, staying on authorized nonmotorized routes.
cards.short_summary: A year-round riverfront network with more than 20 miles of trails.
cards.evidence_claim: North Dakota Tourism lists The Greenway as having free admission, year-round availability, and more than 20 miles of multi-purpose trails.
cards.source_title: The Greenway | North Dakota Tourism
cards.access_notes: Open year-round; Grand Forks municipal code states the Greenway is generally open to the public from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UND study environments with distinct work settings, technology, and access considerations.

cards.title: Reading Room (The Fishbowl)
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · second floor
cards.notes: Bring reading or solo drafting to this named second-floor library room; check the floor map on arrival and follow any posted room-use guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named reading room inside UND’s main library.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries’ Chester Fritz Library floor map identifies the Reading Room, also called “The Fishbowl,” on the second floor.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Use during Chester Fritz Library open hours and comply with posted room guidance.

cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · first, third, and fourth floors
cards.notes: Choose a listed room for contained work with a partner or small group; consult the floor map and library policy before relying on a room.
cards.short_summary: Map-listed study rooms across several Chester Fritz Library floors.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries’ floor maps list study rooms on the first, third, and fourth floors of Chester Fritz Library.
cards.source_title: Floor Maps | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Library policy gives students first-come, first-served priority, with occasional administrative reservations possible.

cards.entity_name: Chester Fritz Library Main Computer Lab
cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Main Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use this lab when an assignment needs a campus workstation, scanner, or uPrint station; save files regularly and arrive with your login ready.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor workstation environment with scanning and printing nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries states that Chester Fritz Library’s main computer lab is on the second floor and includes scanners and a uPrint station.
cards.source_title: Computers and Technology | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Computers are first-come, first-served whenever the library is open.

cards.title: Chester Fritz Library Collab Stations
cards.subtitle: Chester Fritz Library · selected study rooms
cards.notes: Plan a group session around a collaborative workstation when shared display and video chat help; ask library staff which study room has one available.
cards.short_summary: Selected study rooms offer mobile collaborative workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries reports three collaborative workstations in some Chester Fritz Library study rooms, each with a 46-inch display and webcam.
cards.source_title: Computers and Technology | Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on the study room; confirm location and room access with library staff.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Quiet Floors
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · basement and third floor
cards.notes: For quiet legal reading or concentrated writing, use the designated basement or third-floor quiet setting and keep conversations for another floor.
cards.short_summary: Two designated quiet floors in UND’s law library.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law identifies the basement and third floors of Thormodsgard Law Library as quiet study floors.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The library lists weekday public hours; law students may use UCard access 24/7.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Collaborative Floors
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · first and second floors
cards.notes: Bring discussion-based work to the library’s collaborative floors, then move to the quiet floors when the task shifts to individual reading or drafting.
cards.short_summary: Two law-library floors explicitly designated for collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law identifies the first and second floors of Thormodsgard Law Library as collaborative study floors.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The library lists weekday public hours; law students may use UCard access 24/7.

cards.title: Thormodsgard Law Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thormodsgard Law Library · individual and group rooms
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused pair or group session, or use an empty room while remaining ready to yield it to a reservation holder.
cards.short_summary: Ten individual and group study rooms with a documented reservation process.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Law lists ten individual and group study rooms at Thormodsgard Law Library and sets a two-consecutive-hour reservation guideline.
cards.source_title: About the Law Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Rooms may be used when empty, but reservations take priority; reservations are limited to two consecutive hours without prior permission.

cards.title: Gordon Erickson Music Library
cards.subtitle: Hughes Fine Arts Center · Room 170
cards.notes: Use this specialized library when scores, recordings, or music reference materials support your assignment; confirm its separate hours before walking over.
cards.short_summary: A music-focused library with listening facilities and specialized collections.
cards.evidence_claim: UND Libraries states that Gordon Erickson Music Library has sound recordings, scores, reference materials, and music listening facilities.
cards.source_title: Gordon Erickson Music Library | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The Music Library has its own posted hours; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Gershman Graduate Center Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Gershman Graduate Center · reservable collaboration space
cards.notes: Graduate students can reserve a meeting room for a planned work session; use the reservation process and keep the purpose tied to graduate education.
cards.short_summary: Reservable meeting rooms in a center dedicated to graduate students.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that the Gershman Graduate Center has multiple meeting rooms students may reserve for collaboration and that graduate students may reserve space for graduate education.
cards.source_title: Gershman Graduate Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Graduate students and the campus community may reserve space for graduate-education purposes; after-hours access uses a UCard.

cards.title: Student Group Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union · Room 232
cards.notes: Meet in this named Memorial Union collaboration space for student-group planning; use the building map to locate Room 232 and confirm availability first.
cards.short_summary: A named collaboration room in the Memorial Union.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s Memorial Union building map lists Student Group Collaboration Space in Room 232 and describes the union as having study and meeting spaces.
cards.source_title: Building Map | Memorial Union | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Room availability may be affected by student-group and building scheduling; check with the Memorial Union before planning a meeting.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Named public-facing stops along the University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor from UND toward downtown Grand Forks.

cards.title: University Park
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 320 N 25th St
cards.notes: Walk over for the floral gardens, then choose a low-key activity from the trails, tennis courts, playground, or seasonal rink.
cards.short_summary: A park stop with gardens and several recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: University Park is near UND and includes trails, floral gardens, tennis courts, play equipment, a skating rink, and a spray park.
cards.source_title: University Park | Grand Forks Park District
cards.access_notes: Park amenities vary by season; check the Park District page before planning a specific activity.

cards.title: Red Pepper University
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1011 University Ave
cards.notes: Use this University Avenue counter-service stop when you want a meal break; review its current menu and ordering options before going.
cards.short_summary: A named University Avenue restaurant serving grinders and Mexican fare.
cards.evidence_claim: Red Pepper University is located at 1011 University Avenue and serves grinders and Mexican fare.
cards.source_title: Red Pepper University | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Food purchases are required; confirm service details directly with the restaurant.

cards.title: Archives Coffee House
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 3012 University Ave
cards.notes: Stop for a coffee or pastry on the University Avenue side of campus, and check the shop’s current offerings before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A coffeehouse at 3012 University Avenue with drinks, pastries, and sandwiches.
cards.evidence_claim: Archives Coffee House is at 3012 University Avenue and offers coffee and tea drinks, fresh-baked pastries, and sandwiches.
cards.source_title: 7 FORKS local coffee hot spots | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Food and drinks require purchase; verify current service before visiting.

cards.title: Empire Arts Center
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 415 DeMers Ave
cards.notes: Check the calendar for a film, concert, gallery visit, or Empire Theatre Company production before making the downtown walk.
cards.short_summary: A historic downtown theater and gallery facility on DeMers Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Empire Arts Center is a circa-1919 movie house turned theater and gallery that hosts concerts, films, theater productions, and special events.
cards.source_title: Five places to discover FORKSful of cool culture | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Programs and admission conditions vary by event; consult the venue calendar.

cards.title: Fire Hall Theatre
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 412 2nd Ave N
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled performance at this downtown venue, then plan your route from DeMers Avenue one block north to the theater.
cards.short_summary: A 100-seat performance venue in a renovated historic fire hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fire Hall Theatre is a renovated former Number One Fire Hall with a 100-seat performance venue.
cards.source_title: Five places to discover FORKSful of cool culture | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Performance availability and admission vary; check the theater schedule.

cards.title: Town Square
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; DeMers Ave & N 3rd St
cards.notes: Use the square as a downtown meetup point, then check its event listings or simply explore the play area and public gathering space.
cards.short_summary: A year-round downtown gathering place at DeMers Avenue and North 3rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Town Square hosts community events and festivals and includes a kids’ play area and seasonal ice-skating activity.
cards.source_title: Town Square | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Events and seasonal features have separate schedules; consult the current calendar.

cards.title: Grand Forks Mural
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1 S 3rd St, Town Square
cards.notes: Pause at Town Square’s painted landmark and photograph it from the plaza; the source identifies its artists, commissioner, and 2022 installation.
cards.short_summary: A 2022 public mural at Town Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grand Forks Mural at Town Square was installed in 2022, created by Three Brushketeers, and commissioned by the Downtown Development Association and UND.
cards.source_title: Grand Forks Mural | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork at Town Square; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: Paddlewheel Sculpture
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; 1 S 3rd St, Town Square
cards.notes: Find the welded stainless-steel paddlewheel at the Town Square entrance and use it as a clear landmark before exploring nearby DeMers Avenue.
cards.short_summary: A stainless-steel paddlewheel sculpture marking Town Square’s entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: The Paddlewheel Sculpture at Town Square is a welded stainless-steel work installed in 2000 and commissioned by the City of Grand Forks.
cards.source_title: Paddlewheel Sculpture at Town Square | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork at the Town Square entrance; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: Flood Memorial Park
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; North 3rd St downtown
cards.notes: Add this small downtown pause while walking near Town Square; use the public art and memorial setting to reflect on the city’s flood history.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown pocket park on North 3rd Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Flood Memorial Park is one of the downtown pocket parks on North 3rd Street, where public art reflects local history and surroundings.
cards.source_title: Pocket Parks | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor pocket park; access depends on public-space conditions.

cards.title: The Greenway
cards.subtitle: University Avenue–DeMers Avenue corridor; downtown Red River access
cards.notes: Continue from downtown toward the river for a walk or bike ride, and use the published map to select a trail segment that fits your time.
cards.short_summary: A 2,200-acre riverfront greenway with an all-season trail system.
cards.evidence_claim: The Greenway spans 2,200 acres along the Red and Red Lake rivers and includes an all-season trail system, nature preserves, picnic sites, and camping areas.
cards.source_title: The Greenway | Visit Grand Forks
cards.access_notes: Choose an appropriate trail segment and check conditions before biking, walking, or using river access.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Documented University of North Dakota ceremonies, gatherings, and campus practices with direct institutional sources.

cards.title: Mark UND’s February birthday
cards.subtitle: Annual Founders Day observance
cards.notes: Watch UND’s Founders Day announcements each February to see how the university marks its 1883 founding and recognizes campus service.
cards.short_summary: A February banquet tradition that began in 1904.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says its Founders Day tradition started in 1904 and annually aligns with the university’s February 27, 1883 founding date.
cards.source_title: UND Founders Day
cards.access_notes: Event format and attendance details vary; consult the current Founders Day page.

cards.title: See cultures take the stage
cards.subtitle: UND International Organization’s annual celebration
cards.notes: Follow the International Organization’s event details for the annual dinner, cultural displays, and performances started by students in 1961.
cards.short_summary: A student-organized multicultural gathering with a 1961 origin.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that Feast of Nations began in 1961, was organized by students in the International Organization, and is hosted annually.
cards.source_title: About Feast of Nations
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for the event; review the current Feast of Nations information before attending.

cards.title: Join the Homecoming parade route
cards.subtitle: Annual UND fall tradition
cards.notes: Check the annual Homecoming schedule for parade, volunteer, alumni, and game-day events rather than assuming a repeating program.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong fall tradition first held at UND in 1916.
cards.evidence_claim: UND reports that its first Homecoming was held in 1916 and that the annual celebration has grown into a week of events.
cards.source_title: PHOTOS: Celebrate UND Homecoming Week 2024
cards.access_notes: Use the current UND Homecoming schedule for dates, locations, and participation details.

cards.title: Learn UND’s school song
cards.subtitle: University song tradition
cards.notes: Use UND’s published lyrics to recognize the school song at university occasions and athletic events; participate only where appropriate.
cards.short_summary: UND’s official school song pledges loyalty to North Dakota.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s history page identifies “Stand Up and Cheer” as its school song and publishes its lyrics.
cards.source_title: History of UND
cards.access_notes: The official lyrics and a linked performance are available on UND’s history page.

cards.title: Spot the original prairie-rose colors
cards.subtitle: UND’s founding-color tradition
cards.notes: Look for historically themed green-and-pink displays and read the university’s account of why students chose the colors in 1889.
cards.short_summary: UND continues to recognize green and pink alongside today’s green and white.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says 25 students selected green and pink in 1889, and that the university continues to celebrate their special significance.
cards.source_title: History of UND
cards.access_notes: This is a historical color legacy, not a scheduled event; see UND’s history page for context.

cards.entity_name: RAIN Traditional Meal and Honor Ceremony
cards.title: Honor RAIN graduates through ceremony
cards.subtitle: College of Nursing & Professional Disciplines
cards.notes: Follow RAIN’s spring announcements for its graduate celebration, which includes a shared meal, Star Quilt presentations, honor songs, and a Friendship Dance.
cards.short_summary: A spring RAIN graduate celebration rooted in culture and community.
cards.evidence_claim: UND says the RAIN Program hosts a spring Traditional Meal and Honor Ceremony featuring a traditional meal, Star Quilt presentations, honor songs, and a Friendship Dance.
cards.source_title: Honoring our History and Traditions
cards.access_notes: This program-specific ceremony is hosted each spring; consult RAIN for participation details.

cards.entity_name: College of Engineering & Mines Ring Ceremony
cards.title: Witness the engineer’s commitment
cards.subtitle: UND College of Engineering & Mines
cards.notes: Look for the college’s Ring Ceremony coverage to see graduating engineers and scientists mark their commitment to ethical professional practice.
cards.short_summary: A time-honored UND engineering milestone tied to professional responsibility.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes its Ring Ceremony as a time-honored college event where students commit to ethical practice, service, and lifelong professionalism.
cards.source_title: VIDEO: 2026 Spring Ring Ceremony
cards.access_notes: This ceremony is associated with College of Engineering & Mines students; check college announcements for invitations.

cards.title: Welcome new citizens on Constitution Day
cards.subtitle: Memorial Union observance
cards.notes: Check UND’s September Constitution Day program for the campus naturalization ceremony and related public events before making plans.
cards.short_summary: A recent annual campus observance on September 17.
cards.evidence_claim: UND reported that, over the past few years, holding a naturalization ceremony on campus on September 17 has become an annual tradition.
cards.source_title: UND to celebrate Constitution Day on Sept. 17
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current year’s Constitution Day program; the cited ceremony was listed at the Memorial Union.

cards.title: Follow UND football’s holiday giving tradition
cards.subtitle: UND Football community initiative
cards.notes: Read the annual Holiday Magic From Markus updates to understand how UND football players help prepare and deliver gifts for participating families.
cards.short_summary: A football-led holiday initiative that has continued for more than two decades.
cards.evidence_claim: UND reports that Holiday Magic From Markus has been a UND Football tradition for more than 20 years, with players shopping for, wrapping, and delivering gifts.
cards.source_title: STORY and VIDEO: The Magic endures
cards.access_notes: This is a football-program giving initiative; follow its current updates rather than expecting public participation.

cards.title: Look for Old Main’s oak in the procession
cards.subtitle: UND commencement ceremonial object
cards.notes: At a UND commencement, watch for the mace carried by a marshal and placed on stage as part of the academic procession.
cards.short_summary: A commencement mace made from oak from UND’s first building, Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that its mace, made from oak from Old Main, is carried by a marshal during academic processions and placed on stage at commencement.
cards.source_title: Academic Pageantry & Dress
cards.access_notes: The mace appears as part of commencement ceremonial protocol; attend only through the event’s applicable invitation or ticket process.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of North Dakota, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence of campus and nearby Grand Forks stops: get oriented, move around, find culture, then choose a scheduled evening event.

cards.title: Start at the Social Stairs
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Memorial Union
cards.notes: Use the tiered seating as a simple meeting point, then check the Memorial Union’s services and building map before splitting off to explore.
cards.short_summary: A central indoor rendezvous point for beginning the weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: UND describes the Memorial Union as the heart of campus, and its Social Stairs are a campus gathering space.
cards.source_title: Services & Amenities | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Academic-year Memorial Union hours listed: Sunday 11 a.m.–midnight; Monday–Thursday 7 a.m.–midnight; Friday–Saturday until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Get your bearings at Chester Fritz Library
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus research library
cards.notes: Walk through the library and identify a study spot, service desk, and the route back to your residence before the campus gets more familiar.
cards.short_summary: An orientation stop centered on UND’s main research library.
cards.evidence_claim: Chester Fritz Library is UND’s library for research, reference, library services and spaces, and collections.
cards.source_title: Chester Fritz Library
cards.access_notes: Check the library website for current building access and service hours before going.

cards.title: See the current MUG exhibition
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Memorial Union, Room 140
cards.notes: Take a short gallery lap and read one label closely; rotating exhibitions make this an easy repeat stop when friends visit later in term.
cards.short_summary: A compact on-campus art stop with changing shows.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s Memorial Union Gallery hosts rotating exhibitions, with shows changing about every 90 days.
cards.source_title: Memorial Union Gallery | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: The gallery page lists exhibition-specific hours; confirm the current show and hours before visiting.

cards.title: Try the Rock Wall
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Bring your U Card, sign the required annual waiver if needed, and ask an attendant about beginner-friendly climbing before getting on the wall.
cards.short_summary: A beginner-accessible indoor climbing activity at the Wellness Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that no climbing experience is necessary and that the Rock Wall is available to UND students and Wellness Center members at no extra cost.
cards.source_title: Rock Wall | Wellness Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Access requires UND student or Wellness Center membership status; visit during Rock Wall operating hours.

cards.title: Play a round at NEXUS
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Ask the desk how to use the gaming PCs, then choose a short session that leaves time for the rest of the day’s campus exploration.
cards.short_summary: A named recreational esports lounge with gaming PCs.
cards.evidence_claim: UND identifies NEXUS as its recreational esports gaming lounge and says it has twelve gaming PCs.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Confirm current lounge availability and eligibility with the Wellness Center before visiting.

cards.title: Make time for table tennis
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · UND Wellness Center
cards.notes: Check out paddles and a ball at the welcome desk with your ID, then invite a new neighbor for a casual game between other plans.
cards.short_summary: A simple, equipment-supported indoor activity for two or more people.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that Wellness Center members can play table tennis and check out paddles and a ball free from the welcome desk using ID.
cards.source_title: Wellness Center Features | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Table tennis is for Wellness Center members; bring ID and ask the welcome desk about equipment availability.

cards.title: Step into North Dakota Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · 261 Centennial Drive
cards.notes: Browse the current exhibition at your own pace, then pause outside to orient yourself on the west side of campus before heading back.
cards.short_summary: A campus art museum with rotating exhibitions and no general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: UND reports that North Dakota Museum of Art has no general admission, although it suggests a donation.
cards.source_title: NDMOA opening ‘Stories of Place: Select Recent Acquisitions’ exhibition Sept. 5
cards.access_notes: The cited UND notice lists museum hours as weekdays 9 a.m.–5 p.m. and weekends 1–5 p.m.; verify current exhibition hours before visiting.

cards.title: Take a daylight Greenway walk
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Grand Forks riverfront
cards.notes: Choose a mapped segment, share your route with your group, and turn around with ample daylight so the walk stays a relaxed first-weekend outing.
cards.short_summary: An expansive public outdoor recreation area along the Red River.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Grand Forks describes the Greenway as a 2,200-acre outdoor recreational area spanning Grand Forks and East Grand Forks.
cards.source_title: Greenway | City of Grand Forks, ND
cards.access_notes: Use the City’s Greenway maps and activity information to select an appropriate route and conditions.

cards.title: Pause at University Park
cards.subtitle: Saturday late afternoon · 320 N 25th Street
cards.notes: Use the park as a calm reset between campus plans; in winter, check whether an outdoor-rink activity is scheduled before making it your destination.
cards.short_summary: A nearby named park that also hosts outdoor-rink programming.
cards.evidence_claim: UND’s calendar lists University Park at 320 N 25th Street and identifies its Outdoor Rink as the location for rink scrimmages.
cards.source_title: University Park | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Outdoor-rink activities are seasonal; check the calendar and weather before traveling there.

cards.title: Choose an evening at the Chester Fritz
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · 3475 University Avenue
cards.notes: Check the current event calendar, choose an age-appropriate performance, and buy tickets only if a scheduled show and your budget line up.
cards.short_summary: A campus venue for concerts, theatre, dance, and university events.
cards.evidence_claim: UND states that the Chester Fritz Performing Arts Center hosts programming ranging from concerts and opera to ballet, symphonies, Broadway shows, and university events.
cards.source_title: Chester Fritz Performing Arts Center | University of North Dakota
cards.access_notes: Tickets are required for many events; verify the current calendar, ticket policy, start time, and age guidance before attending.
